title: Bank security team: suspicious transaction
hook: A suspicious payment was blocked on your card and must be verified now

opening_line.voice: Good afternoon, this is the security team at your bank. We have blocked a suspicious payment on your card and I need to verify it with you.
opening_line.sms: Bank Security: a suspicious payment was attempted on your card. If this was not you, reply to this message now so we can block it.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Establish that a suspicious payment was attempted and that you are from the bank's security team
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Say the payment will go through within minutes unless the card is verified on this call
stage_goals.ASK: Say a verification code has been sent to their phone, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Do you have the six-digit code we just sent to your phone in front of you?
red_flags: The bank called you, you did not call the bank
A request for a one-time code

lesson.headline: Your bank will never ask for a one-time code
three_points: A one-time code approves a payment. Anyone who asks for it is trying to take money, not protect it.
Real bank staff never rush you. Hang up and call the number printed on your card.
A caller knowing your name or part of your card number proves nothing.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.voice: السلام عليكم، معاك قسم الأمان في البنك. وقّفنا عملية دفع مشبوهة على بطاقتك ولازم نتأكد منها وياك الحين.
opening_line.sms: أمن البنك: صارت محاولة دفع مشبوهة على بطاقتك. إذا ما كنت إنت، رد على هالرسالة الحين عشان نوقفها.

ar.commit_question: الرمز اللي وصلك على تلفونك من ستة أرقام، موجود جدامك الحين؟
red_flags: البنك هو اللي اتصل فيك، مب إنت اللي اتصلت

lesson.headline: البنك ما يطلب منك رمز التحقق أبداً
three_points: رمز التحقق يوافق على عملية دفع. أي حد يطلبه يبي ياخذ فلوسك، مب يحميها.
موظف البنك الحقيقي ما يستعجلك. سكّر الخط واتصل على الرقم المكتوب على بطاقتك.
إذا المتصل يعرف اسمك أو جزء من رقم بطاقتك، هذا ما يثبت شي.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
